certification.name: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity Specialization
certification.description: Five-course ISC2 specialization covering security principles, incident response and business continuity, access control, network security and security operations, aligned to the Certified in Cybersecurity exam domains. Course-based certificate assessed through quizzes and case studies; the proctored CC exam is separate.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
